title: Port of Iberia Bridge Replacement – Port Road Over Commercial Canal (TV-0028)
intro: A three-stop look at this CPRA project: where it is, what it changes, and its status and funding.

steps.title: Where it's at
steps.body: This project is on Port Road in Iberia Parish, where it crosses Commercial Canal near the Port of Iberia.

media.alt: Aerial view of Port Road and the Port of Iberia area where it crosses Commercial Canal (2024 aerial imagery).

steps.title: What it is changing
steps.body: The old bridge was a timber-and-precast structure in extremely poor condition. It was replaced with a new pre-cast concrete bridge built to safely carry the heavy daily traffic — employees, residents, and commercial trucks — that depends on this route to reach the Port of Iberia.

steps.title: Timeline / Completion Date
steps.body: Project Status: Completed. Estimated Cost: $625,792. Funding Source: Coastal Impact Assistance Program (CIAP).
